title: hemipilia amplexifolia
intro: Hemipilia amplexifolia, commonly known as the Yellow Orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Hemipilia amplexifolia include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
